touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Torksey qualifies as a local detour through THE PADDOCKS CASTLE VIEW and CHURCH OF ST PETER. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Torksey: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Torksey offers THE PADDOCKS CASTLE VIEW, CHURCH OF ST PETER, GRAVESTONE 8 PACES FROM SE ANGLE OF NAVE OF CHURCH OF ST PETER within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: THE PADDOCKS CASTLE VIEW
